Flight booking

To perform a flight from/to Sheremetyevo International Airport (ICAO: UUEE, IATA: SVO) during the «Moscow RFE 2023» event, you must first book the desired flight on this website. During the booking process, you can choose either a scheduled flight or a non-scheduled (charter) flight.

Charter flights can be booked using the Departure/Arrival section. They are marked in the table with the PRIVATE identifier. When booking a charter flight, what type of aircraft you will use, as well as determine your own departure/arrival airfield.

Return flights are also available for booking where possible.

If necessary, you can cancel your reservation at any time using the «My bookings» section.

Before flight please make sure you have a VALID AIRAC 2308

 

General

Flight procedures in the Russian Federation airspace do not differ much from the international standards.

Flights in the vicinity of the aerodrome shall be carried out along SID, STAR routes, routes of entry into/exit from the airways, approach charts and RNAV routes for each direction of all runways. Various route options for each landing direction are established in the vicinity of the aerodrome to ensure coordination of the approach sequence. Flight crews must maintain the assigned standard instrument departure routes (SID) and standard instrument arrival routes (STAR) and in case of deviation — join the assigned track immediately. Take-off noise restrictions are published on SID charts.

On arrival, please do not descend on your own, even if your FMC/MCDU indicates the TOD. Before starting the descent, be sure to obtain the appropriate clearance from the approach ATC unit (radio callsign «Moscow-Approach») or from the area control centre ATC unit (radio callsign «Moscow-Control»). If there is no such clearance, descent on your own is strictly prohibited.

When selected STAR and type of approach, don't forget to select IAF (Initial Approach Fix) in VIA or TRANS menu (depending on the aircraft model).
When flying in: 
Sheremetyevo - KEZVU

After landing, please vacate the active runway as soon as possible. Please also do not hesitate to use high-speed taxiways on which you can move at speeds up to 60 knots. Remember that spacing between aircraft on the final approach path can be extremely small, and you can interfere with the approach and landing of other pilots.

Please be discreet and kind towards others. Do not interrupt each other on the active frequency. When connecting to the voice channel, do not start talking immediately. Please maintain a 5-10 second gap in order to avoid sudden interruption into radio communications of other pilots.

 

Indicated airspeed restrictions

You must maintain the indicated air speeds (IAS) and altitudes specified in the arrival/approach/departure charts

If you cannot maintain these speeds or altitudes, notify the responsible ATS unit.

 

Sheremetyevo International Airport  (ICAO: UUEE, IATA: SVO)

 

Pushing back (towing), starting up and taxiing procedures

When flying from Sheremetyevo International Airport, please do not connect to the network earlier than 30 minutes before the estimated departure time. If, after connecting to the network, it turns out that your parking stand is occupied by someone else, then move to the adjacent (free) parking stand.

Clearance shall be requested within 5 to 15 minutes before TOBT (Target off-block time).

Take-off from RWY 24L, 24C, 06R, 06C shall be carried out as follows:
- from intersection with TWY G4, A8 – for RWY 24L;
- from intersection with TWY G4, B6 – for RWY 24C;
- from intersection with TWY G2, A2 – for RWY 06R;
- from intersection with TWY G2, B2 – for RWY 06C.
When full RWY distances are required, the flight crew shall advise this to “Sheremetyevo-Delivery” controller after obtaining departure clearance.

ACFT must leave the stand not later than 1 min after clearance for towing and engines start-up. The engines are started up at specially designated points that are indicated on the Sheremetyevo ground movements chart. ATC unit of the taxiing control position (radio callsign «Sheremetyevo-Ground») will inform you about the start-up point when issuing pushing back or towing clearance. In this case, you must first push back or tow your aircraft to the specified point and only after that start up the aircraft engines.

Changeover to communication with TWR controller shall be carried out by GND controller’s instruction: «AFL 1700, contact TWR 131.5». Having received this instruction, the flight crew must reset radio to the assigned frequency, make sure that the channel is vacant, establish radio contact with TWR controller.

Changeover to communication with TWR controller can be carried out by the instruction of GND controller: «AFL 1700, standby for TWR 131.5». In this case the flight crew must change over to the assigned frequency, monitor it, waiting for TWR controller to make contact. 

 

Departure procedures

There are definite initial climb altitudes in Sheremetyevo according SID.

Initially cleared climb altitude after take-off for SIDs with route indicators E, H is 7000 ft.
Initially cleared climb altitude after take-off for SIDs with route indicators F, G, J, K is 4000 ft.

The pilot-in-command shall start movement within 10 seconds after obtaining take-off clearance.
If the aircraft movement has not begun after the expiration of 10 seconds, TWR controller can prohibit take-off and give the instruction to the flight crew to clear the runway via the nearest TWY.

When the runway is AVBL only for take-off, «Sheremetyevo-Tower» controller can issue conditional clearance which is the instruction to the flight crew to line up at own discretion from the runway beginning after the preceding aircraft which has started the take-off run.
«AFL 1234, “Sheremetyevo-Tower”, RWY 24L line up in sequence». 
After start of the take-off run by a preceding aircraft, pilot shall taxi to line-up position and wait for further instructions.

 

Arrival procedures

After receiving the instruction «Contact Sheremetyevo-Tower 131.5» from «Sheremetyevo-Radar» controller, pilot shall tune the radio station to the mentioned frequency and contact «Sheremetyevo-Tower» controller advising ACFT call sign and selected approach procedure:
«Sheremetyevo-Tower, AFL 1713, ILS 24C».
«Sheremetyevo-Tower» controller confirms establishing radio communication by a phrase indicating the index of runway for landing: «AFL 1713, Sheremetyevo Tower, 24C». Which means «Continue approach, runway 24C».
The pilot shall confirm:
«24C, AFL 1713»

If the type of approach, chosen by the pilot and advised to ATS unit, differs from the type of approach broadcasted in ATIS message, the controller indicates it on initial contact:
«AFL 1713, RNAV 24C approach».
The pilot shall confirm:
«RNAV 24C approach, AFL 1713».

Application of the reduced runway separation minima

Take-off clearance can be issued to the flight crew of the ACFT, if there is well-grounded confidence, that at the moment of commencement of the accelerated movement of this ACFT on the runway the preceding departing aircraft is airborne and has already passed the point located at a distance of not less than 2500 m from the succeeding ACFT
Restriction on initial climb height and information about air traffic can be issued to the flight crew of the succeeding ACFT:
«AFL1702, initially climb 3600 ft, be informed preceding traffic (ACFT type), RWY 24L, cleared for take-off».


Landing clearance is issued to flight crews of arriving ACFT under the following conditions:
- the preceding ACFT has landed and passed the point located at a distance of not less than 2500 m from RWY THR and there is well-grounded confidence, that this ACFT will be in motion and will vacate RWY without backtracking, when the succeeding arriving ACFT will be crossing RWY THR;
- the departing ACFT is airborne and has passed the point located at a distance of at least 2500 m from RWY THR.

The flight crew of the succeeding ACFT is informed about the preceding ACFT by indicating the type of the preceding ACFT in landing clearance. RWY of landing designator is indicated in landing clearance:
«AFL 1703, be informed preceding traffic (ACFT type), RWY 24L, cleared to land».

Pilot-in-command can make a decision to land on the occupied RWY, provided, that the preceding ACFT has passed the point located at a distance of 2500 m from runway threshold. The flight crew shall inform the controller when the preceding ACFT is in sight and confirm landing clearance.
«AFL1703, (ACFT type) in sight, RWY 24L, cleared to land».

Reasonable confidence of the controller is based on observance by the flight crews of the published time of RWY occupation after landing (or passing the distance of not less than 2500 m from RWY threshold).

If the flight crew is not ready to observe the published requirements, the flight crew must inform the controller about it on initial radio contact or as early as possible.

Information about application of reduced separation minima is included into ATIS message.

Charts

The presence of appropriate charts on board is a prerequisite for the flight. Executing any procedures at airports without charts is absolutely unacceptable.

You can find up-to-date air navigation charts and other useful information in AIP of Russia, book #1. To find air navigation charts of Russian International Airports, you need to follow the path: AIP. Aeronautical Information Publication > AD Part III. Aerodromes > AD 2. Aerodromes > International aerodromes of the Russian Federation.

 

Sceneries

You can find up-to-date airport sceneries in the «Sceneries» section of the Eastern Europe and Northern Asia MCD website. We highly recommend you download and install the sceneries provided there. We believe that it will be unpleasant for you if another aircraft appears where it should not be (inside the terminal, on the taxiway or even on the active runway). Take just 3 minutes to download and install the scenery. Thus, both you and we will get more pleasure from the event.

All sceneries listed on the Eastern Europe and Northern Asia MCD website are freeware. However, you can download and install well-known payware sceneries.

MTL and X-CSL

Make sure you have the latest MTL and X-CSL versions installed before flying. Otherwise, you will not be able to enjoy different aircraft liveries during the «Moscow RFE 2023» event.

Use the MTL Updater to install and download MTL.

Use the X-CSL Package website to install and download X-CSL.

Full installation is recommended for optimal realism.

 

Do you still have questions?

If you have any further questions or concerns, please feel free to contact Moscow FIR Chief by e-mail uuwv-ch@ivao.aero.
